messages:
maria.marketing: Quick heads-up — planning announcement for the Adaptive Batching feature next Wednesday EOD PST. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URL, canary timing from eng, and confirmation of webinar slot so we can include registration link in the post.

aj.eng: Can do. Canary window available Thu morning (09:00–11:00 PST) — we can run a 2hr canary at 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics look good. Need changelog freeze by Wed 15:00 PST.

katie.product: Docs are 90% done. I'll push the final edits to the release branch today and publish staged docs at: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/releases/adaptive-batching-1.3 — will update to prod URL after QA.

dylan.sales: For inbound routing, please tag leads from the webinar with utm_campaign=adaptive-batching and assign to the "AI-Integrations" SFDC queue. Can we attach a form field that asks "Are you evaluating for production?" so SDRs can prioritize?

sam.ops: Rollout policy: start with 10% global, 1h step to 50% if latency/errs OK, then 24h observation before 100%. We have a rollback play: revert to batching-v1 and scale down worker pools. I'll prepare runbook.

maria.marketing: Awesome — action items: (1) eng provide changelog file link, (2) prod docs URL, (3) webinar registration URL + CTAs, (4) routing tags & form fields. Marketing will prepare the announcement copy + short benchmark blurb.

aj.eng: Changelog is autogenerated from the release branch. Use this staging endpoint to pull the canonical file: `curl -s https://staging.redwood.ai/internal/changelog/latest | jq -r .markdown`

aj.eng: I'll also drop a minimal human-friendly changelog at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/releases/adaptive-batching-1.3/changelog.md by EOD.

katie.product: Webinar confirmed for Tue 2pm PT (60m + 15m Q&A). Registration link: https://events.redwood.ai/adaptive-batching — will add the registration form with the question for 'production evaluation' and a hidden utm param.

dylan.sales: Perfect. Once the form is live, can we get an export of registrants as CSV with those fields? SDRs will triage next-day.

sam.ops: Release-bot scheduled the canary for Thu 10:00 PST. If we see error rate > 1% or p95 latency +30% baseline, automatic rollback will trigger and page oncall.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled by Aj (eng) — canary start: 1769580000 (Thu 10:00 PST). Notified channels: #eng-oncall, #incidents.

maria.marketing: Draft announcement copy (very short): "Adaptive Batching: 2–4x token throughput for bursty workloads, with predictable latency controls. Docs + benchmarks live. Demo webinar Tue 2pm PT — register: https://events.redwood.ai/adaptive-batching" — please iterate on messaging if it overpromises.

aj.eng: Messaging nit: say "up to 4x" and include typical latency impact for 99th pct. Suggest: "up to 4x throughput for bursty workloads while keeping 99th pct latency within 20% of baseline (varies by model)."

katie.product: I'll add a short benchmark table to the docs and a one-slide summary for marketing.

maria.marketing: Can someone drop the final prod docs & changelog links here by Wed 15:00 PST? We need them for the scheduled social & blog publish hook.

aj.eng: Will confirm prod changelog link by 1769525400 (Wed 14:30 PST).

sam.ops: I'll upload the runbook and rollback steps to the ops folder and share the link in #eng-oncall before canary.

dylan.sales: One more ask — please include a short copy snippet for SDRs: 2 lines that explain the business win (cost/latency) so outreach is consistent.

maria.marketing: Putting that on my list. Final check: if anything blocks the docs -> let us know early. Otherwise we'll schedule the blog & social for Wed 17:00 PST with the canary Thursday morning. :thumbsup:

aj.eng: LGTM.

katie.product: LGTM.

dylan.sales: :rocket:

sam.ops: :ok_hand:
